name: vocaret
description: Say what you want typed and it is written at your caret. Local speech recognition; works with Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Gemini, local models and more.

commands.title: Vocaret: Type an Instruction Instead of Speaking
Vocaret: Install or Update Speech Engine
Vocaret: Check Setup (Microphone, Speech Model, Provider)

enumDescriptions: Claude through the Claude Code CLI. Uses your Claude subscription login; no API key.
OpenAI models through the Codex CLI. Uses your ChatGPT subscription login; no API key.
Claude through the Anthropic API (API key).
OpenRouter: one API key for models from many vendors.
Google Gemini through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint (API key).
Ollama running on this machine. No key; nothing leaves your computer.
LM Studio running on this machine. No key; nothing leaves your computer.
vocaret.provider.markdownDescription: Which model service writes the code. The easiest way to switch is the command **Vocaret: Choose Provider and Model**, which also asks for an API key when one is needed.

vocaret.model.markdownDescription: Model name for the chosen provider, exactly as that provider spells it. Empty uses the provider's default where there is one (`sonnet` for Claude Code).

vocaret.effort.description: Reasoning effort, for providers that have such a setting. Low keeps voice typing snappy.

vocaret.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Endpoint for the `custom` provider, e.g. `http://localhost:8080/v1`. Also overrides the built-in URL of an OpenAI-compatible provider (useful for proxies).

vocaret.apiKeyEnv.markdownDescription: Environment variable to read the API key from, if you would rather not store it with **Vocaret: Set API Key**. Empty uses the provider's usual one (`OPENAI_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, ...).

vocaret.extraBody.markdownDescription: Extra JSON fields added to requests to OpenAI-compatible providers, e.g. `{"temperature": 0}`.

vocaret.timeoutSeconds.description: Give up on the model after this many seconds.

vocaret.autoStopSilenceSeconds.description: Finish automatically after this many seconds of silence. 0 (default) means you finish by pressing the shortcut again, so pauses while you think are fine.

vocaret.speechModel.markdownDescription: Whisper model for speech recognition. `auto` uses `large-v3-turbo` on an NVIDIA GPU and `small.en` on CPU. Any faster-whisper model name works (`medium.en`, `distil-large-v3`, ...).

vocaret.language.description: Language you speak, as a code (en, de, es, ...). Leave empty to auto-detect (needs a multilingual speech model).

vocaret.recorderCommand.markdownDescription: Custom capture command that writes raw 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM to stdout, for picking a specific microphone. Example: `arecord -q -D hw:1 -f S16_LE -r 16000 -c 1 -t raw -`. Empty uses the system default input.

vocaret.highlightChanges.description: Briefly highlight what a voice instruction changed.

vocaret.command.description: Path of the vocaret launcher, if it is not in ~/.local/bin.
